Theorem
[Approximate Busemann--Feller projection] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0506, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0507, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0508 ↗ lem:chow-iii-i42-tubular-projection 1. appi:1.43,appi:1.44\group Tubular neighborhoods

For every smooth path $\gamma $ in the positive tube of radius $\varepsilon \le \ell (\Lambda ,\kappa )$, \[ \mathcal L(\pi \circ \gamma )\le \left(\cos (\varepsilon \kappa )-\frac\Lambda \kappa \sin (\varepsilon \kappa )\right)^{-1} \mathcal L(\gamma ). \]
